bull_bear.body: Disciplined approach; ECB loan repayment rescheduled to Jun-27 compliant with RBI guidelines; No dividend/buyback commentary; Focus on ROCE improvement.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Raw material volatility (geopolitical); FX fluctuations (net positive but volatile); Low institutional shareholding impacting liquidity/valuation; Regulatory changes on plastic/recycling.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, transparent, and disciplined; New CFO (ex-P&G) emphasizes ethical accounting and profitable growth over vanity metrics; Defensive on market share loss (strategic choice).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: The INR 88mn depreciation charge was an accounting correction (WDV to SLM) for prior years, not an operational cash burn; Management explicitly states they are not 'profiteering' from war-induced inflation but using it to enforce price discipline.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- At the end of Q2 26 Net Debt is "Nil", with cash and cash equivalents and other bank balances of MINR 2,706 and investment of MINR 1,253 in liquid mutual funds.
- Unutilized fund-based limits with bank stood at MINR 4,272, and gross debt "remains constant in December 2025" with Net Debt nil.
- Balance sheet described as stable: Debt-Equity Ratio 0.1 at both Jun-26 and Dec-25; Current Ratio 2.2 (Jun-26) vs 2.4 (Dec-25); Total Equity MINR 13,488 (Jun-26) vs MINR 12,935 (Dec-25).
- The deck notes operating working capital was "impacted mainly due to higher inventory and higher trade receivable" (MINR 4,643 at Jun-26 vs MINR 3,051 at Dec-25), and that "Lower investments supported the higher working capital".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

bull_bear.body:
- Deep vertical integration and technology leadership across MDO-PE, blown film extrusion, high-barrier metallisation, gravure/flexo/digital printing, extrusion and solvent/solventless lamination, hot-melt coatings and cold-seal technologies
- Access to Huhtamaki's global flexible packaging network in addition to 10 manufacturing sites in India
- Export footprint spanning 70+ countries, contributing 33.51% of turnover
- blueloop™ recyclable mono-material packaging platform (PE, PP, paper) supporting customers' transition to a circular economy
- Diversified portfolio across flexible packaging, labels and cylinders serving food & beverage, home & personal care, healthcare and pet-food customers
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body: - Cybersecurity and data risk — Increasing digitalisation of operations and growing reliance on data-driven systems expose the Company to cyber threats, data breaches and associated regulatory compliance challenges; such risks may result in financial loss, operational disruption, or reputational impact if not adequately mitigated. The Company responds through IT security architecture, user-access controls, periodic cybersecurity audits, vulnerability assessments and employee training.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Focus on innovation-led, premium segments (MNCs like Unilever/Nestle) rather than volume-driven regional markets; exiting non-aligned low-value business.

business.body:
- The deck states the company is "Aligned with our global strategy" and "remains focused on profitable growth, disciplined capital allocation, and stronger accountability".
- Management frames the quarter as "Delivered profitable growth through strong execution across volume, pricing and efficiency", with pricing offsetting commodity hurts from the middle east crisis.
- Investor communication runs through the Huhtamaki group (investor.communication@huhtamaki.com; huhtamaki.com flexible-packaging investors page), signalling the listed Indian entity's integration with the global flexible-packaging business.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [One-time charges] Margins were "partially impacted by a one-time impairment charge"; separately, "H1 2026 includes a non-recurring MINR 88 depreciation adjustment, partly offset by a MINR 22 deferred tax benefit."
- [Calendar reporting] The company reports on a calendar year: "Q1 - Mar quarter, Q2 - June Quarter, Q3 - Sept Quarter and Q4 - Dec Quarter", and "H1 - Jan to June and H2 - July to Dec".
- [Reporting schedule] Next disclosure flagged for October 27, 2026: "Financial result Q3 and Q1-Q3 2026".
business.title: Notable from the deck

business.body: The Company manufactures and sells flexible packaging materials (reel and pre-made pouches, high-barrier laminates, shrink sleeves), pressure-sensitive and specialty labels, and laser-engraved cylinders, primarily for FMCG customers. Over 55% of its packaging is used in the food & beverage industry, with the remainder serving home care, personal care, cosmetics, healthcare, pet food and industrial applications. It operates 10 manufacturing plants across India and exports to more than 70 countries.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Flexible Packaging:** Reel form laminates, High-barrier laminates, Pre-made pouches (stand-up, shaped, spouted, flat-bottom, 5-panel), Shrink sleeves, Wrap-around labels, Pressure-sensitive labels, Digital-printed packs, Specialised packaging solutions for high-speed lines
- **Labels:** Hanger Labels, Reclosable Labels, Braille Labels, Squeezable Wrinkle-Free Labels for Tubes and Pouches, High & Low-temperature Resistant Labels, Transfer Labels, Tamper-proof Seal Labels, Backside Printing and Numbering, Variable Data Labels, Hologram Labels, Dome Labels, Metallic Gold and Silver Printed Labels
- **Cylinders:** Laser engraved cylinders
business.title: Products & brands

business.body:
- Deep vertical integration and technology leadership across MDO-PE, blown film extrusion, high-barrier metallisation, gravure/flexo/digital printing, extrusion and solvent/solventless lamination, hot-melt coatings and cold-seal technologies
- Access to Huhtamaki's global flexible packaging network in addition to 10 manufacturing sites in India
- Export footprint spanning 70+ countries, contributing 33.51% of turnover
- blueloop™ recyclable mono-material packaging platform (PE, PP, paper) supporting customers' transition to a circular economy
- Diversified portfolio across flexible packaging, labels and cylinders serving food & beverage, home & personal care, healthcare and pet-food customers
business.title: Competitive strengths

latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue: Low-single digit organic growth expected; Margin: Sequential improvement trajectory confirmed; Order inflow: Stable demand from premium FMCG; Capex: Solar captive project at Khopoli going live in H2CY26.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: N/A (Production based on FMCG customer schedules); management notes 'ample room to grow' without capacity constraints.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Organic growth via capacity utilization (currently not a constraint); Sustainability-led product differentiation (PCR content); Potential future inorganic deals (currently not on radar).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

outlook.body:
- Calibrating India strategy to accelerate growth and lead responsibly, aspiring to be the first choice in sustainable packaging solutions
- Three value drivers guiding forward agenda: Accelerated Profitable Growth, Disciplined Capital Allocation, and Accountability and Speed of Execution
- Accelerated Profitable Growth: intensifying engagement with key customers, increasing wallet share where value is differentiated, and selectively expanding into segments aligned with capabilities and return thresholds
- Disciplined Capital Allocation: maximising returns from recent infrastructure/equipment/system investments, identifying the right projects, executing on time and within approved budgets with clear accountability, and allocating capital selectively toward initiatives that accelerate competitiveness and strengthen sustainability performance
- Core strategy of improving operational efficiency, leveraging technology-led innovation and enhancing value realisation from products, while expanding the profitable core business and implementing key transformation initiatives across the organisation
- Advancing and commercially scaling mono-material and post-consumer recycled (PCR) content packaging solutions under the parent group's Strategy 2030 sustainability framework
- Digital transformation across manufacturing and IT — shopfloor digitalisation, ERP transformation, IT standardisation, cybersecurity strengthening and digital governance — supporting the goal of World Class Operations (WCO) across all sites
- Declaration of dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended December 31, 2025 is placed before shareholders as ordinary business at the AGM. No further capital-allocation philosophy (balance-sheet/reinvestment intent) is disclosed within this governance bundle; the corporate governance framework is stated to be founded on transparency, accountability, disclosure and integrity.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: No greenfield/brownfield capacity addition or named capex project with a commissioning timeline is disclosed in this bundle. Disclosed activity is limited to plant-level energy-conservation and efficiency initiatives implemented during 2025 across manufacturing sites (Contract Demand Optimization at Taloja, Ambernath, Baddi and Guwahati; Compressed Air System Optimization at Guwahati; Chiller and Cooling System Optimization at Silvassa, Khopoli, Ambernath and other sites; VFD installation at Khopoli, Silvassa, Sricity and other locations; Thermic Fluid and Fuel efficiency improvements at Silvassa and Khopoli; Ventilation and Air Curtain reduction at Khopoli; UV System upgradation at Ambernath and Baddi), plus an exceptional gain from the sale of assets relating to closed plants.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Revenue decline was anticipated and strategic, stemming from conscious decisions to exit or scale down lower-margin businesses and refine product/customer mix in favour of higher-quality, more sustainable revenue streams
- EBITDA margin expansion driven by structural improvements in manufacturing efficiency, procurement discipline and overhead control, supported by disciplined portfolio decisions and improved operating leverage
- India remains a structurally attractive long-term growth market, with steady consumption trends among downstream customers, supported by evolving consumer preferences and continued innovation in the FMCG sector
- Commercial delivery of blueloop™ recyclable solutions expanded to meet rising customer demand, with strong growth in large pack and specialty packaging segments
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

The new CFO signals a disciplined era of profitable growth over volume chasing, with capacity headroom for organic expansion.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Huhtamaki India is a leading manufacturer of flexible packaging, decorative labels and laser-engraved cylinders in India, with over seven decades of local operating history and access to the global Huhtamaki packaging network.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: The Company manufactures and sells flexible packaging materials (reel and pre-made pouches, high-barrier laminates, shrink sleeves), pressure-sensitive and specialty labels, and laser-engraved cylinders, primarily for FMCG customers. Over 55% of its packaging is used in the food & beverage industry, with the remainder serving home care, personal care, cosmetics, healthcare, pet food and industrial applications. It operates 10 manufacturing plants across India and exports to more than 70 countries.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: Focus on innovation-led, premium segments (MNCs like Unilever/Nestle) rather than volume-driven regional markets; exiting non-aligned low-value business.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Flexible Packaging:** Reel form laminates, High-barrier laminates, Pre-made pouches (stand-up, shaped, spouted, flat-bottom, 5-panel), Shrink sleeves, Wrap-around labels, Pressure-sensitive labels, Digital-printed packs, Specialised packaging solutions for high-speed lines
- **Labels:** Hanger Labels, Reclosable Labels, Braille Labels, Squeezable Wrinkle-Free Labels for Tubes and Pouches, High & Low-temperature Resistant Labels, Transfer Labels, Tamper-proof Seal Labels, Backside Printing and Numbering, Variable Data Labels, Hologram Labels, Dome Labels, Metallic Gold and Silver Printed Labels
- **Cylinders:** Laser engraved cylinders

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Food
- Beverages
- Home and Personal Care
- Pet Food
- Healthcare (intravenous & enteral solutions, OTC/nutritional supplements, prescriptive, transdermal patches)
- Exports to 70+ countries, contributing 33.51% of turnover in FY2025
- Domestic markets across 28 Indian states and 8 Union Territories

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: N/A (Production based on FMCG customer schedules); management notes 'ample room to grow' without capacity constraints.

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: Revenue: Low-single digit organic growth expected; Margin: Sequential improvement trajectory confirmed; Order inflow: Stable demand from premium FMCG; Capex: Solar captive project at Khopoli going live in H2CY26.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Organic growth via capacity utilization (currently not a constraint); Sustainability-led product differentiation (PCR content); Potential future inorganic deals (currently not on radar).

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue decline was anticipated and strategic, stemming from conscious decisions to exit or scale down lower-margin businesses and refine product/customer mix in favour of higher-quality, more sustainable revenue streams
- EBITDA margin expansion driven by structural improvements in manufacturing efficiency, procurement discipline and overhead control, supported by disciplined portfolio decisions and improved operating leverage
- India remains a structurally attractive long-term growth market, with steady consumption trends among downstream customers, supported by evolving consumer preferences and continued innovation in the FMCG sector
- Commercial delivery of blueloop™ recyclable solutions expanded to meet rising customer demand, with strong growth in large pack and specialty packaging segments

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: Raw material inflation (low-to-mid double digits) fully passed through to customers with minimal lag; Mix shift to higher-value products driving structural margin expansion; Operational efficiency gains.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Disciplined approach; ECB loan repayment rescheduled to Jun-27 compliant with RBI guidelines; No dividend/buyback commentary; Focus on ROCE improvement.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: No greenfield/brownfield capacity addition or named capex project with a commissioning timeline is disclosed in this bundle. Disclosed activity is limited to plant-level energy-conservation and efficiency initiatives implemented during 2025 across manufacturing sites (Contract Demand Optimization at Taloja, Ambernath, Baddi and Guwahati; Compressed Air System Optimization at Guwahati; Chiller and Cooling System Optimization at Silvassa, Khopoli, Ambernath and other sites; VFD installation at Khopoli, Silvassa, Sricity and other locations; Thermic Fluid and Fuel efficiency improvements at Silvassa and Khopoli; Ventilation and Air Curtain reduction at Khopoli; UV System upgradation at Ambernath and Baddi), plus an exceptional gain from the sale of assets relating to closed plants.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident, transparent, and disciplined; New CFO (ex-P&G) emphasizes ethical accounting and profitable growth over vanity metrics; Defensive on market share loss (strategic choice).

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Deep vertical integration and technology leadership across MDO-PE, blown film extrusion, high-barrier metallisation, gravure/flexo/digital printing, extrusion and solvent/solventless lamination, hot-melt coatings and cold-seal technologies
- Access to Huhtamaki's global flexible packaging network in addition to 10 manufacturing sites in India
- Export footprint spanning 70+ countries, contributing 33.51% of turnover
- blueloop™ recyclable mono-material packaging platform (PE, PP, paper) supporting customers' transition to a circular economy
- Diversified portfolio across flexible packaging, labels and cylinders serving food & beverage, home & personal care, healthcare and pet-food customers

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Raw material volatility (geopolitical); FX fluctuations (net positive but volatile); Low institutional shareholding impacting liquidity/valuation; Regulatory changes on plastic/recycling.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: The INR 88mn depreciation charge was an accounting correction (WDV to SLM) for prior years, not an operational cash burn; Management explicitly states they are not 'profiteering' from war-induced inflation but using it to enforce price discipline.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Calibrating India strategy to accelerate growth and lead responsibly, aspiring to be the first choice in sustainable packaging solutions
- Three value drivers guiding forward agenda: Accelerated Profitable Growth, Disciplined Capital Allocation, and Accountability and Speed of Execution
- Accelerated Profitable Growth: intensifying engagement with key customers, increasing wallet share where value is differentiated, and selectively expanding into segments aligned with capabilities and return thresholds
- Disciplined Capital Allocation: maximising returns from recent infrastructure/equipment/system …
